usageNotes: Removes a Ceph Monitor daemon from the specified node; requires at least one other monitor in the cluster (Proxmox refuses to remove the last mon). The caller needs `Sys.Modify` at the root level. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task API to confirm completion before treating the monitor as gone.

examples.summary: Remove a monitor named 'pve2' from node pve2 after adding a replacement monitor elsewhere

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the Ceph Monitor daemon from the node, reducing quorum capacity; if only two monitors remain after removal, a single further failure will cause the cluster to lose quorum and become read-only.
tips: Verify monitor count with GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/mon before deleting — the API blocks removal of the last mon, but dropping below three mons reduces fault tolerance.
The monid typically matches the node hostname; confirm the exact ID from the mon list endpoint before issuing the delete.
Manager daemons on the same node are unaffected — use DELETE /nodes/{node}/ceph/mgr/{id} separately if the mgr also needs removal.
The return value is a UPID string; use the tasks API (GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status) to poll for completion.
